svg.title: CareConnect - Reviews
svg.desc: One of exactly six screen designs. All shown names, records, amounts and chart values are illustrative layout data. Reference style: white header, teal navigation, pale background and rounded cards.
svg.text: Global patient feedback and flexible medical references, together on one screen.
Ratings and tags are aggregated together.
A review can contain more than one tag.
Unknown nested fields expand here, as readable text.
Document 1 of 40 · read-only reference; not a prescription
